name: SilverBullet
install: OS=$(uname -s | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); ARCH=$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/aarch64/'); curl -sL https://github.com/silverbulletmd/silverbullet/releases/latest/download/silverbullet-server-$OS-$ARCH.zip -o sb.zip && unzip -o sb.zip silverbullet && rm sb.zip && chmod +x silverbullet && mkdir -p space
notes: markdown notes wiki; single self-contained server binary, keyless in --single mode
